title: Change reveals a new shared principle

captions.energy: Ending an account with exhausted grounds
captions.emotions: Feeling supported by a clear principle

meaning: Your shared view can find a clear principle when changed conditions let you end an explanation that no longer fits.
text: A clear principle sometimes offers support after an earlier account ends. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Ajna suggests updating explanations alongside conditions. Death in energy supports wanting to finish an account whose grounds have been exhausted. The Hierophant in emotions feels confidence in an accessible shared rule. You may feel comfortable that a new arrangement has substance and needs no endless comparison with the earlier one. Your view names what stopped explaining the material and which principle now makes details’ connections understandable to both.

For example, you examine a new edition of a desk calendar. Page colour previously marked the month; it now relates to an illustration’s subject. **Ending an earlier account can reveal a clear shared principle.** You update your view and stop explaining every shade through season. The new rule becomes accessible to both. It feels pleasing to see why neighbouring pages differ. Your picture gains support while the old explanation remains only for the earlier edition. Present material needs no return to it whenever a familiar colour appears.

The risk is dismissing the earlier principle as always meaningless after gaining confidence in the new one. Ending an account erases the conditions under which it worked. Wanting to finish what is exhausted preserves time and scale: a new rule explains the present arrangement while an old one retains grounds in its own material.
